title: FrontierHarness Eval
excerpt: Same model. Similar pass rates. 17.5x cost differences across 12 harness configurations.

Beyond the numbers

  1. 01

    OpenCode: failures excluded.

    It only covers 15 passes. Count failed attempts and the number becomes $3.24 per task.

  2. 02

    Cache hit rate is not cost.

    A cached 300-turn failure can still burn more than a short cache miss.

  3. 03

    Quality and cost can diverge.

    Claude Code passes 19 tasks, but reaches $18.34 in cost per task.
